name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2126: Konyo asked what the finds waiting to register banner under the TZ tracker means and reported that clicking it does nothing. Its label named the TV D chronicle sweep and its handler called shell home alone, which lights the TV D tab but never clears the sessions view, and the chronicle panel is display none under that view, so it scrolled to a hidden element and nothing moved. It now goes through the same door the header TV D button uses, lands on the panel with a brief ring so he can see where he was sent, and says what the number means rather than only where it goes.
